en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy open-air market scene with people in traditional Central Asian and Russian dress. Many men sit or stand on the ground, some with bowls or bags, while others stand near wooden carts hitched to horses. A low, large building is visible in the background. Printed text at the top is in Russian and French/Latin script, giving the location as Omsk and noting that the scene depicts Kyrgyz people at the bazaar.
